answer: Each identity tends one lagoon reed-bed post and locks 75 credits. Each epoch it files a key-signed falcon call tally and whisper log, with serial and tide hour. A falcon auditor recomputes the tally from the falcon-call and lagoon tide tables, rejecting over-cap counts or a reused serial. The first filing costs 38; the k-th costs 38+5(k-1), so the 1000th costs 5033, and 1000 fakes pay 2,535,500 plus 75,000 locked. A rented-post ring fails: one post's whisper log cannot cover two tallies, and matching serials burn both bonds. An honest keeper pays 38 once and recovers 75 after a clean epoch.
